evidence.quote: Personal information: Name, address, email address, postal code, password and other information you may provide with your account, such as your gender, mobile phone number, date of birth, anniversary date, user bio, nationality and website.
evidence.heading: Information You Provide to Us​

evidence.quote: This includes IP address, device type, operating system, browser type and version, unique device identifiers (such as Apple IDFA, Android Advertising ID, or other manufacturer-assigned IDs), mobile network information, device settings (like language, time zone), connection type and speed, and potentially the device's telephone number associated with the SIM card or device.
evidence.heading: Information We Collect Through Automatic Data Collection Technologies​

G1.rationale: The company collects personal data that goes beyond basic account details, including device information and usage data.

evidence.quote: Third-party advertisers and partners accessible via our Services use their own tracking technologies (like cookies and device IDs) to collect data about your Service usage.
evidence.heading: How we use the information we collect​

evidence.quote: We also allow ad networks (e.g., Google Analytics, DoubleClick) to serve tailored ads directly on our Services using their own tracking technologies.
evidence.heading: How we use the information we collect​

G2.rationale: The company allows third-party ad networks and partners to use tracking technologies on the services to collect data and serve tailored ads, without describing a first-party opt-out mechanism.

evidence.quote: Service Improvement, Personalization & Research: Understand our users (behavior, preferences, feature usage) to improve the content and features of our Service, personalize your experience by offering customized content, deals, and other services based on your preferences and interests
evidence.heading: How we use the information we collect​

evidence.quote: enable us to show you advertisements relevant to your likely interests and administer promotions, contests, and sweepstakes.
evidence.heading: How we use the information we collect​

G3.rationale: The policy describes building profiles and personalizing experiences/ads based on user preferences and behavior without detailing a direct self-service user control to stop profiling.

evidence.quote: These recordings and associated data may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined above, comply with legal obligations, enforce our agreements, or as otherwise required for our legitimate business needs.
evidence.heading: How we use the information we collect​

G4.rationale: Retention periods are described in purpose-based terms ('as long as reasonably necessary') rather than providing concrete time periods for user data.

evidence.quote: Deletion: If you would like to permanently delete your account, please use the "Contact Us" link at the bottom of every page (also located here).
evidence.heading: Your Information​

evidence.quote: Your right to review, update, correct, and delete your information is subject to our records retention policies and applicable law, including any statutory retention requirements.
evidence.heading: Your Information​

G5.rationale: The policy mentions rights to review, update, correct, and delete, but subjects them to records retention policies and statutory requirements, and deletion is framed around deleting the account.

evidence.quote: Eternal may process and retain your personal information on its servers in India where its data centers are located, and/or on the servers of its third parties (in or outside India), having contractual relationships with Eternal.
evidence.heading: Data Storage​

G6.rationale: Data may be stored on servers outside India with third parties, and no specific standard transfer mechanism (like SCCs or DPF) is named.

evidence.quote: Permissible Age: By using the Services, you represent and warrant that you are either at least 18 years of age or have the express permission of a parent or legal guardian to use the Services.
evidence.heading: Applicability and Scope​

evidence.quote: Our Services are generally not directed to or intended for use by individuals under the age of 18 ("Minors"), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from Minors for the purposes of creating an account or for general use of our platform.
evidence.heading: Data of Minors​

G7.rationale: The service sets an under-18 age threshold and requires parental permission or blocks general account creation for minors.

evidence.quote: We may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to process Personal Data in order to enhance our services, improve user experience, and ensure the security and integrity of our operations.
evidence.heading: How we use the information we collect​

evidence.quote: These AI tools may analyze Personal Data to identify patterns, detect anomalies, and provide personalized recommendations.
evidence.heading: How we use the information we collect​

AI1.rationale: The company uses AI tools and technologies to process and analyze personal data to enhance services and provide recommendations without offering a specific opt-out.

AI2.rationale: The policy does not describe any specific way or toggle for users to opt out of AI processing or training.

AI3.rationale: no sentence matched the flag's search terms; absence not verified

evidence.quote: As a result, our use and disclosure of aggregated and/or de-identified information is not restricted by this Privacy Policy, and it may be used and disclosed to others without limitation.
evidence.heading: How we use the information we collect​

AI4.rationale: The policy explicitly states that de-identified or aggregated information is not restricted by the privacy policy and may be used and disclosed without limitation.

evidence.quote: Nugget leverages third-party Large Language Model (LLM) services via API integrations.
evidence.heading: Nugget AI​

evidence.quote: Eternal selects and manages these LLM integrations, but the ultimate processing by the LLM provider is subject to their specific technical protocols and data handling practices.
evidence.heading: Nugget AI​

AI5.rationale: User content processed through the Nugget AI platform is transmitted to third-party LLM providers, though managed via specific integrations and terms.

evidence.quote: By accessing or using Eternal’s Services and/or registering for an account with Eternal or any of its affiliates, you agree to this privacy policy and you provide your informed consent
evidence.heading: Applicability and Scope​

DPDP1.rationale: Consent is obtained through browsewrap terms via accessing or using the services.

evidence.quote: You can manage your email and notification preferences and follow the "unsubscribe" instructions for commercial email messages.
evidence.heading: Your Information​

DPDP2.rationale: Consent withdrawal or preference management is limited to commercial email messages and notifications.

evidence.quote: If you have any queries relating to the processing/ usage of information provided by you or regarding Eternal’s Privacy Policy, you may email the Data Protection Officer (DPO) at privacy@zomato.com .
evidence.heading: Contact Us​

DPDP3.rationale: The policy designates a Data Protection Officer (DPO) and provides an email contact route.

DPDP4.rationale: There is no mention of the notice being available in Eighth Schedule Indian languages.
